answer: A protocol assigns each identity one submission slot per epoch via VRF over seed and pubkey, a nonce window no juniper of prior rounds predicts. Only within that window is an answer accepted; miss it and the identity yields nothing. No relic of past slots carries forward since reshuffles are random. A thousand-key farm faces a thousand scattered nonces, each needing its own clock, impossible to batch or share. The atlas of all slots is unknowable pre-reveal, blocking precompute. Operators pay linear per-key coordination with zero scale economies; every missed slot is permanent loss.
